title: MQM-APE: Toward High-Quality Error Annotation Predictors with Automatic Post-Editing in LLM Translation Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of presented translations (Translation A vs. Translation B) in the pairwise quality verifier to mitigate and account for the LLM's preference based on presentation order.

Comparing the distribution of error categories (e.g., style, terminology) generated by LLM evaluators against human-annotated MQM data to detect and reduce the systematic over-representation or generation bias of specific error types.
